entries.title: Yomawari: Night Alone

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC; Vita3K/PPSSPP-style Vita emulation not needed for the primary route
emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: The Steam PC release is the best fidelity/capture route for Yomawari: Night Alone, while the Vita and Switch collection versions are alternate access or portability routes with no sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Yomawari: Night Alone on Steam for the primary route. Use the Switch Long Night Collection if you want both early games together on a console/handheld.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch release is a collection bundle, not a remake or remaster of Night Alone.
